project.title: ማሙሽ - የእናት ፍቅር
project.logline: In the mist-covered Ethiopian highlands, a devoted rural mother named Mamush sacrifices her comfort and guides her young son across rain-swollen trails so he can reach his schoolhouse—and as he grows older, her love remains the strength that helps him overcome every obstacle.

characters.name: Mamush (ማሙሽ)
characters.visual_bible: Ethiopian woman in her mid-30s with warm dark brown skin, braided hair partially covered by a traditional white handwoven cotton netela shawl with subtle woven border, earthy woven dress, weathered gentle hands, resilient and loving expression.

characters.name: Dawit (ዳዊት)
characters.visual_bible: Eight-year-old rural Ethiopian boy with short curly hair, faded navy knit sweater over a cotton shirt, dusty khaki shorts, worn rubber sandals, carrying a cloth-wrapped notebook and small canvas satchel.

style_guide.visual_style: Naturalistic cinematic realism, 35mm film grain texture, intimate documentary-inspired framing of Ethiopian highland countryside.
style_guide.lighting: Soft natural golden-hour and overcast highland daylight, gentle volumetric morning mist, warm hearth glow indoors.
style_guide.cinematography_notes: Grounded eye-level perspective, shallow depth of field on emotional faces, sweeping wide establishing frames for landscape scale.
style_guide.negative_prompt: modern skyscrapers, paved highways, neon lights, anime, cartoon, 3d render plastic skin, distorted hands, extra limbs, text overlay, watermark

music.prompt: Warm Ethiopian acoustic film score featuring washint bamboo flute, gentle krar lyre plucking, and expressive masinko strings, evolving from quiet morning intimacy to determined emotional crescendo and hopeful resolution.
music.lyrics_or_tags: instrumental, ethiopian folk cinematic, washint, krar, masinko, warm, emotional, acoustic

shots.setting: Terraced Ethiopian highlands overlooking a small traditional mud-and-thatch homestead surrounded by eucalyptus and acacia trees.

narration.text_am: በኢትዮጵያ ደጋማ አካባቢዎች ጎህ ሲቀድ፣ ማሙሽ የምትባል እናት በትንሽ ጎጆዋ ውስጥ ከሌሎች ቀድማ ከእንቅልፏ ትነሳለች።
narration.text_en: As dawn breaks across the Ethiopian highlands, a mother named Mamush wakes in her small homestead before anyone else.

keyframe.prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Cinematic extreme wide shot of rural Ethiopian highlands at dawn, mist drifting across green terraced hills, traditional round mud-and-thatch gojo home with thin morning hearth smoke rising, golden sunrise light, 35mm film grain.
keyframe.negative_prompt: modern buildings, power lines, asphalt road, watermark

video.motion_prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Gentle morning mist drifts across the valley while thin woodsmoke rises slowly from the homestead roof as camera pans slowly right.

shots.setting: Warm, dimly lit interior of the traditional mud-brick home illuminated by doorway sunlight and ember glow.

narration.text_am: ለራሷ የሚበቃ ባይኖራትም፣ የልጇን ደብተር በንጹህ ጨርቅ ጠቅልላ ለትምህርት ታዘጋጃለች።
narration.text_en: Though she barely has enough for herself, she wraps her son's notebook in clean cloth and prepares him for school.

keyframe.prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Medium close-up inside a rustic Ethiopian rural home, warm sunbeam cutting through doorway dust, Ethiopian mother Mamush in white cotton netela wrapping a worn school notebook in protective cloth for her smiling eight-year-old son.
keyframe.negative_prompt: modern kitchen, fluorescent lighting, plastic furniture, watermark

video.motion_prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Mamush ties the cloth gently around the notebook and hands the satchel to her son as dust motes float in the morning sunbeam, subtle camera push-in.

shots.scene_title: Stepping Onto the Red Earth Trail
shots.setting: Winding red-clay footpath flanked by wild grass and flat-topped acacia trees.

narration.text_am: የገጠሩ ቀይ መንገድ ረጅምና አስቸጋሪ ቢሆንም፣ በጽናትና በተስፋ ጉዟቸውን ይጀምራሉ።
narration.text_en: Though the rural red-earth road is long and unforgiving, they begin their journey with resilience and hope.

keyframe.prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Medium wide shot of Ethiopian mother Mamush walking hand in hand with her young son along a red-earth countryside footpath, green highland meadows and acacia trees, gathering distant rain clouds on the horizon.
keyframe.negative_prompt: cars, paved sidewalk, modern backpacks, watermark

video.motion_prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Mother and son walk forward along the winding dirt path while morning breeze ripples through tall grass, smooth tracking follow shot.

shots.setting: Steep muddy hillside path beside a swollen seasonal stream under heavy rain.

narration.text_am: ዝናቡ ሲበረታ፣ መንገዱም በጭቃና በጎርፍ ሲሞላ፣ ልጁ ጉዞውን ሊያቆም ይፈልጋል፤ እናቱ ግን ተስፋ እንዲቆርጥ አትፈቅድለትም።
narration.text_en: When the rain intensifies and the path fills with mud and floodwater, the boy wants to stop—yet his mother refuses to let him lose hope.

keyframe.prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Dramatic cinematic medium shot in heavy Ethiopian highland rain, mud-splattered trail beside a rushing brown seasonal creek, young boy sitting on a wet stone looking down at a snapped rubber sandal while Mamush shields him.
keyframe.negative_prompt: umbrellas, raincoats, dry pavement, studio lighting, watermark

video.motion_prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Raindrops splash onto the muddy path and swollen stream while Mamush kneels urgently beside her shivering son, gentle handheld motion.

shots.scene_title: A Mother's Shawl and Crossing the Stream
shots.setting: Shallow rocky crossing of the rain-swollen rural stream.

narration.text_am: ነጠላዋን ለደብተሩ መጠለያ አድርጋ፣ ልጇን በጀርባዋ አዝላ ውሃው የሞላውን ወንዝ በትጋት ታሻግረዋለች።
narration.text_en: Using her netela shawl to shelter his notebook, she lifts her son onto her back and steadfastly carries him across the swollen river.

keyframe.prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Emotional medium wide shot of determined Ethiopian mother Mamush wading barefoot across stepping stones in a shallow muddy stream, carrying her young son on her back with his notebook satchel wrapped safely in her white shawl.
keyframe.negative_prompt: bridges, modern boots, smiling posed look, watermark

video.motion_prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Mamush steps steadily from stone to stone through swirling shallow water carrying her son securely while rain eases around them.

shots.setting: Dry ridge overlooking a sunlit valley with a small rural school visible in the distance.

narration.text_am: "ልጄ ሆይ፣ የምትሄድበት መንገድ አስቸጋሪ ቢሆንም አትደንግጥ፤ ሁሌም ጠንካራ ሁን" በማለት በፍቅር ታበረታታዋለች።
narration.text_en: "My son, even though the road you walk is hard, do not be afraid; always stay strong," she tells him with loving encouragement.

keyframe.prompt: [PLACEHOLDER] Over-the-shoulder cinematic shot from behind Mamush kneeling to tie a cloth strip around her son's sandal, sunlit green Ethiopian valley ahead with a modest tin-roofed rural schoolhouse perched on the ridge.

shots.setting: Open dirt courtyard of a rural highland primary school with children gathering under an acacia tree.

narration.text_am: ጊዜ እያለፈ ልጁ ሲያድግ፣ በሕይወት የተለያዩ ፈተናዎችን ቢያጋጥመውም፣ የእናቱ ፍቅርና ድጋፍ በልቡ ውስጥ የጥንካሬ ምንጭ ሆኖ ይቀጥላል።
narration.text_en: As time passes and the boy grows older, though life brings many trials, his mother's love and support remain a source of strength within his heart.

shots.setting: Sunlit ridge path overlooking the schoolyard below.

narration.text_am: የእናት ፍቅር ማንኛውንም መሰናክል ለማለፍ ኃይል ይሰጣል፤ ለተሻለ ሕይወትና ለብሩህ ወደፊትም ተስፋን ይፈጥራል።
narration.text_en: A mother's love gives the strength to overcome any obstacle, and sparks hope for a better life and a brighter future.
